name: Rune Winters
caption: The first wrestler to get the owner's new comic-book render in February 2015, with his own bio page on the fed's site; a member remembers a two-week suspension of his.

tenures.source: Named in the owner's poser thread on the fed's own forum, 4 February 2015 to 9 February 2015.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.

name: Tank Adams
caption: A near blank slate of a character who was the owner's first test of the new render model.

tenures.source: Named in the owner's poser thread on the fed's own forum, 4 February 2015 to 4 February 2015.

name: Santos
caption: A character the owner made while learning the new render model, described by him as essentially a Mexican Roman Reigns.

tenures.source: Named in the owner's poser thread on the fed's own forum, 6 February 2015 to 6 February 2015.

name: Sven Deadly
caption: A wrestler with a new gimmick, rendered by a member in June 2015 and, the owner says, a good fit for the active roster if the handler returned.

tenures.source: Named in the owner's poser thread on the fed's own forum, 8 June 2015 to 9 June 2015.

name: Monte Burns
caption: A wrestler whose tiger-skin jacket drew repeated jabs from another member and was changed in the new render in March 2015; he got another new poser in August 2015.

tenures.source: Named in the owner's poser thread on the fed's own forum, 16 February 2015 to 27 August 2015.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.
